Observed natural fault (not injected): while building this candidate's fixture, pilot's own
`wazuh-fim-apply.yml` on the fresh AlmaLinux 9.8 host failed once at `agent-whodata-ensure`
(`native Wazuh audit stream or watches did not appear after restarting the agent`), before the hotfix ran.
The host journal showed Wazuh's own `restart.sh` overlapping pilot's `systemctl restart wazuh-agent`
(`wazuh-syscheckd remains running after unit stopped`, `already running`), leaving a `syscheckd` that started
before the endpoint existed. A rerun of that apply on the same host passed. This is an existing race in the
EL who-data step, not in this change; the same step failed once after an earlier (non-candidate) hotfix
redeploy and passed on retry. It did not occur in arm 3b of this candidate.
